text:
Maya: quick heads-up — found a 404 in the Japanese runtime guide when switching the language selector. anchor '#deploying' returns 404. example: https://docs.redwood.ai/ja/runtime/guide#deploying
Liam: thanks, can you paste the EN link so I can compare slugs?
Maya: EN is https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/guide#deploying — looks like the JA slug got renamed to /ja/runtime-guide in the last restructure, so the anchor path broke.
Maya: I pushed a tiny staging patch and opened a PR to fix existing links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
Maya: sed I used locally to spot the bad paths:
```
sed -n "s#/ja/runtime/guide#/ja/runtime-guide#g" content/**/*.md
```
Liam: nice catch. @Sara could you give that PR a quick review? tagging localization owners.
Sara: will review in ~30m. quick glance looks safe but will check the translated headings for the anchor mismatch.
Ed: fyi the localization sync job skipped that file last night, Ill add a guard so slug renames get mapped. pushing a tiny fix to the sync mapping.
docs-bot: link-checker queued for staging run (requested by Maya). current queue position: 1.
Maya: if Sara approves I'll merge and cherry-pick to main. I can batch any other ja anchor fixes in the same PR. :pray:
Sara: LGTM, small nit in the commit message but not blocking. approving now. :+1:
Maya: merged and deployed to staging. link-checker will re-run and report back. thanks everyone!
note: This thread contains a short code snippet, a PR link, and a bot message.
